claim: Redgif videos have no sounds. : r/BoostForReddit
summary: RedGIFs recently revoked API keys that were given to developers. It's unclear whether they will be providing new keys anytime soon. The keys are needed to access RedGIFs and obtain videos with sound. Otherwise the only option is to use the Reddit fallback video which is silent ¯\ (ツ) /¯ source: I'm a developer for a Reddit app and was notified of this unfortunate circumstance from RedGIFs ...
